::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
This page aggregates every application directory under `private/applications/`
that has been assembled by jobsmith. Sortable / filterable; click any row to
open the per-application review surface.

Privacy: this site renders to `_site/` and should stay local — application
pages contain salary ranges, fit scores, and hiring-manager intelligence.
Run `jobsmith site render --public` to produce a sanitized variant in
`_site-public/` for sharing.
:::

::: {#applications}
